label: E2：SLL数量优化＋die内优先扩散（原动态τ）+SLL位置规划与跨die时序修正；虚拟SLL联合优化修订
scope: full-design placement; original E2 and E1 preserved in their own checkouts

qp.unknowns: real placement-unit coordinates plus one 2D auxiliary anchor per shared SLL crossing
qp.paired_endpoints: entry=anchor; exit=anchor+(out-in) from selected physical channel
qp.coupling: same-die B2B hyperedges and critical sink paths add symmetric real/virtual and virtual/virtual matrix terms
qp.coordinates: AMF common coordinate map; physical COLUMN kept separately
qp.committed_legality: continuous QP candidates are projected before writeback completion to actual channels in the resource table; endpoint pair is updated atomically
qp.refresh: before EVERY QP in joint mode, before STA and at final export; frozen while X/Y solvers run

birth_and_lifetime.initialization: lexicographically nearest feasible source-side entry X; secondary geometry/timing score
birth_and_lifetime.later: retain previous feasible channel as warm start; allow QP/density to change it
birth_and_lifetime.grouping: shared crossing tree; source-local leaves do not cross; remove or recreate according to current pin SLRs

density.bins: unordered SLR boundary, physical COLUMN, floor(min(entryY,exitY)/rowHeight)
density.supply: unique unreserved canonical UBUMP resources, shared by opposite directions
density.demand: one per shared crossing, not one per sink
density.optimizer: derive legal density targets; add springs to auxiliary QP rows; projection minimizes proposal displacement plus marginal density energy and switching cost
density.hard_constraints: canonical channel and fixed IMUX/TX/RX/egress footprint exclusivity
density.candidate_search: incumbent plus up to three feasible geometry groups per available physical column; each available column considered
density.capacity_caveat: bin supply counts UBUMPs; access-node conflicts can reduce usable combinations and are checked exactly during assignment

baseline.sll_quantity: original real-net pin objective; zero gradients on auxiliary SLL variables
baseline.diagnostics: joint QP objective and displacement include auxiliary coordinates; quantity model remains based on original net pins

parameters.SllJointPlacementEnable: true in revised E2 configs; false if omitted for old-config compatibility

existing_flow: STA and optional timing local movement -> QP1 -> QP2 -> ordinary spreading -> region clipping -> conditional hard-resource legalization -> convergence/weight update; joint mode adds refresh and SLL projection within each QP call
limitations: Projected continuous relaxation, not an exact mixed-integer global optimizer.
Heuristic density weights are initial engineering settings, not calibrated full-design QoR results.
Nearest-source is an initialization hypothesis, not a claim about Vivado internals or a permanent lock.
No ordinary CLB area assigned to virtual SLL cells; they use their own SLL capacity model.
Existing real-PU-only frozen replay audit is explicitly rejected in joint mode; joint diagnostic TSV remains supported.
DFX/incremental mode is not supported by E2.
